title: [CQ-R10d] Guest agent CLI runtime and MCP route
description:
Gap found while planning CQ-R10 (2026-10-29), filed for a human decision.

The guest image ships python3 and no Node or agent CLI. No CQ-R task installs a coding/QA CLI, and none gives a CLI an MCP route to the CQ-R08c agent socket (/run/moe/agent.sock), whose protocol is length-prefixed bridge frames, not MCP. CQ-R10 (with R10b and R10c) proves its lifecycle DoD with fake CLIs. CQ-R13 needs this row to certify real isolated agents.

Objective: make the CQ-R10b job table runnable with real CLIs:
- Pinned Linux claude and codex binaries at /opt/moe/agents/<cli>:
  - root:root 0555, never agent-writable;
  - sha256-pinned next to the image pins (certified-provider.json style);
  - copied in without trusting the network on first use, e.g. a copy-only supervisor stream like R09c materialize, or a pinned bootstrap step;
  - readiness reports a hash mismatch.
- A stdlib MCP stdio shim the CLI spawns as its only MCP server. It serves initialize, tools/list and tools/call, maps them onto bridge request frames over the agent socket for exactly the role's guest-bridge.mjs TOOLS allowlist (MOE_ROLE), and uses bounded frames and fixed errors.
- The per-session MCP config written into the session home.
- Each CLI's fixed headless argv and per-role prompt in JOBS. There is never a resume or continue flag; the prompt starts the agent with moe.get_context.

Expect a SPIDR split when planned: binaries and their pinning; the shim; argv and prompt.

Out of scope: lifecycle, leases and termination (R10 final), certification on hardware (R13), and any verified-local or isolation claim.

Verification command (fresh, exit 0 required): node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs
definitionOfDone: Each CLI binary is verified against its pinned sha256 before install, installed root-owned and not agent-writable, and a mismatch fails closed.
The shim reaches Moe only through the agent socket, and only for the role's allowlisted tools. Frames are bounded and errors are fixed codes.
A guest job starts the CLI headless in the workspace with no resume or continue flag. Its MCP config names only the shim.
The verification command exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
taskRails: No direct .moe edits; no Git-write commands by agents; wrappers own landing.
Do not enable verified-local or claim isolation until all requisite implementation and certification gates pass.

implementationPlan.description:
AE harness + AE1 (CQ-R10d composition; tests only, no runtime file changes). Append a '// CQ-R10d end to end' section at the END of scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs, after H8 and after the edits task-2cf1c6be lands there (this task depends on it: it rewires openSession's DAEMON fixture to a fake /health). Reuse, never edit, the existing helpers: LOAD, harness, PEER, NO_GUEST, SUPERVISOR, sessions + after(), openSession, EXIT, SESSION_ID, SPAWNED, KEY, HOST_JOB (claude/ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), QA_HOST_JOB (codex/CODEX_API_KEY), BINDING, QA, launchArgv, LA_CONFIG, rejectsWith, encodeFrame, MAX_HOST_FRAME_BYTES, createFrameDecoder, TOOLS, GUEST_LAYOUT. Every pre-existing row stays byte-identical. No test named AE<n> exists anywhere in scripts/tests (grep-checked).

Harness pieces:
- SHIM_FILE and TOOLS_FILE: guest-mcp-shim.py and guest-mcp-tools.json beside SUPERVISOR.
- NO_TOMLLIB = NO_GUEST || (spawnSync('python3', ['-I', '-c', 'import tomllib']).status !== 0 && 'the fake codex reads config.toml with tomllib (python3 >= 3.11)'). Never spawn python when NO_GUEST is set.
- FAKE_CLI: a constant Python source standing in for /opt/moe/agents/<cli>. It knows only what the real CLI knows:
  - cli = basename(argv[0]).
  - claude reads the JSON file after --mcp-config (key mcpServers); codex reads $CODEX_HOME/config.toml with tomllib (key mcp_servers).
  - It records {cli, argv, cwd, home: $HOME, config: the whole parsed file, replies: [], shim: null}.
  - It continues only if the file holds exactly one server whose command is exactly GUEST_LAYOUT.shim (interpolated with JSON.stringify) and which has no args. It then spawns <dirname(dirname(argv[0]))>/moe-mcp-shim, the local stand-in for that path, with stdin/stdout pipes and stderr inherited.
  - The shim's env is what each CLI gives an MCP server: claude the whole job env; codex only HOME and PATH plus the names in env_vars (pinned codex 0.166, mem gotcha-local-runner-codex-mcp-role-env).
  - It sends one JSON line per message and reads each reply before the next, because the shim drops pending calls at stdin EOF: id 1 initialize {protocolVersion '2025-06-18', capabilities {}, clientInfo}; notifications/initialized (no reply); id 2 tools/list; id 3 tools/call moe.get_context {}; id 4 tools/call of the OTHER role's tool, picked from MOE_ROLE (worker: moe.qa_approve, qa: moe.complete_task), with {}; id 5 tools/call moe.add_comment {content:'e2e', workerId:'someone-else'}; id 6 tools/call moe.add_comment {content:'e2e'}.
  - It closes the shim's stdin, records shim.wait(), and prints the record as one JSON line on stdout.
  - Its first statement is signal.alarm(20), so a hung shim ends the job instead of the run.
- fakeBytes: '#!' + python3's sys.executable (resolved with spawnSync inside the row) + ' -I\n' + FAKE_CLI.
- installFakes(base, frames): spawnSync python3 -I -B -c with LOAD + 'sys.exit(m.install_agents(0, 1, sys.argv[2], (os.getuid(), os.getgid())))', passing SUPERVISOR and <base>/agents. Its input is the frames, each encoded with encodeFrame(frame, MAX_HOST_FRAME_BYTES). agentFrames(cli, bytes, digest = sha256 hex of bytes) = [{kind:'agent', cli, size: bytes.length, sha256: digest}, {kind:'data', data: bytes.toString('base64')}]. The stream ends with {kind:'end'}.
- standIn(base): writes <base>/moe-mcp-shim with mode 0o700.
  - Shebang '#!<python> -IB'; B means no __pycache__ beside the shipped shim.
  - It loads SHIM_FILE with importlib.util.spec_from_file_location, then sets m.AGENT_SOCKET = <base>/agent.sock and m.TOOLS_PATH = TOOLS_FILE. main() reads both module globals at call time.
  - It writes ONE stderr line, json {role: os.environ.get('MOE_ROLE'), env: sorted(os.environ)}: key names only, never values. Then sys.exit(m.main()).
  - Embed paths with JSON.stringify.
- agentMain(base): bridgeMain's shape.
  - spawn records the launch, sets host.socket = <base>/agent.sock, and runs python3 -I -B -c LOAD + code that mkdirs <base>/ws and calls m.main(['bridge'], geteuid=lambda: 0, workspace=<base>/ws, sessions=<base>/sessions, identity=(os.getuid(), os.getgid(), None), jobs={cli: (os.path.join(<base>/agents, os.path.relpath(exe, m.AGENTS)), names) for cli, (exe, names) in m.JOBS.items()}, agent_socket=<base>/agent.sock${PEER}).
  - It pushes host onto sessions, so after() reaps it and removes <base> = dirname(host.socket).
  - The relpath re-rooting is the composition point: the job runs the very file agents mode installed at AGENTS/<cli>.
- Error handling in the harness:
  - assert every spawnSync status with its stderr in the assertion message, so a failed install or harness names its cause;
  - a fake that cannot parse its config or start the shim still prints its record (shim null), so the row fails on a precise field, not on a timeout.

AE1 'end to end, each installed CLI starts headless from its session config and reaches Moe only through the shim and the agent socket' {skip: NO_TOMLLIB, timeout: 60_000}. For each [binding, job] of [BINDING, HOST_JOB], [QA, HOST_JOB], [BINDING, QA_HOST_JOB] and [QA, QA_HOST_JOB], in a fresh mkdtemp base, assert:
1. installFakes with agentFrames('claude', fakeBytes), agentFrames('codex', fakeBytes) and end: status 0; stdout decodes (createFrameDecoder(MAX_HOST_FRAME_BYTES)) to exactly [{kind:'installed', count:2}]; both agents/<cli> are mode 0o555 and hold exactly fakeBytes.
2. Call standIn(base). Then run = openSession(agentMain(base), {binding, job, timeoutMs: 10_000, answer}). The answer throws new Error(UPSTREAM) for moe.add_comment (UPSTREAM is a distinctive marker string) and returns {content:[{type:'text', text: tool}]} otherwise.
3. await run.promise deep-equals {observation: EXIT, executionReady: false}; host.launches deep-equals [SPAWNED]; host.proc.exitCode is 0.
4. report = JSON.parse(the stdout output bytes):
   - report.argv deep-equals launchArgv(job.cli, binding.role, report.home, join(base, 'agents', job.cli)). That is the exact headless argv, which excludes any resume or continue token, and it runs the installed file.
   - cwd is join(base, 'ws').
   - config deep-equals JSON.parse(LA_CONFIG.claude) for claude, and {mcp_servers: {moe: {command: GUEST_LAYOUT.shim, env_vars: ['MOE_ROLE'], default_tools_approval_mode: 'approve'}}} for codex.
   - shim is 0.
   - replies, in order, each a whole {jsonrpc:'2.0', id, ...} object:
     - id 1: assert only result.protocolVersion '2025-06-18' (SH2 owns the rest).
     - id 2: exactly {tools: Object.entries(TABLE[role]).map(([name, properties]) => ({name, inputSchema: {type:'object', properties, additionalProperties:false}}))}, with TABLE = JSON.parse(readFileSync(TOOLS_FILE)). Its names equal Object.keys(TOOLS[role]).
     - id 3: result {content:[{type:'text', text:'moe.get_context'}]}.
     - id 4: error {code:-32602, message:'Tool not available to this role.'}.
     - id 5: error {code:-32602, message:'Argument not allowed for this tool.'}.
     - id 6: error {code:-32004, message:'Moe refused the tool call.', data:{code:'BRIDGE_UPSTREAM_FAILED'}}.
5. run.forwarded deep-equals exactly [['moe.get_context', {taskId:'task-abc', workerId: binding.workerId, sessionId: SESSION_ID}], ['moe.add_comment', {content:'e2e', taskId:'task-abc', workerId: binding.workerId}]]. The denied call and the argument-refused call never reached the host.
6. The stderr output bytes are exactly one JSON line from the stand-in. role equals binding.role, and env includes MOE_ROLE. For codex, env excludes job.credential.name and CODEX_HOME: the role crossed only through env_vars. Do not pin the whole env list: PEP 538 locale coercion adds LC_CTYPE when LANG is absent.
7. Neither KEY nor UPSTREAM appears in any output bytes, the report, or JSON.stringify(host.launches).

Budget: the whole task stays at or under 300 changed lines in this one file (git diff --numstat; comments and blank lines count; QA's cap is 400). ASCII only. Avoid \u escapes, because the Edit tool and heredocs turn them into literal characters (mem gotcha-local-runner-supervisor-tests).

AE2: fail closed on a pin mismatch, and pin the install-to-job layout. Same file, same section. Add `import { AGENT_CLIS } from '../local-runner/agent-cache.mjs';` to the top import block, the host cache's CLI list. Row 'AE2 a CLI binary that misses its pinned sha256 is never installed, so its job never starts, and JOBS runs only agents-mode paths' {skip: NO_GUEST, timeout: 30_000}:
1. Layout pin. harness("print(json.dumps([m.AGENTS, {cli: exe for cli, (exe, _) in m.JOBS.items()}]))") exits 0. Its executable map deep-equals Object.fromEntries(AGENT_CLIS.map(cli => [cli, `${agentsDir}/${cli}`])), where agentsDir is the printed m.AGENTS. So the host cache, agents mode (which installs JOBS keys at AGENTS/<cli>) and the job table name one set of files.
2. Mismatch. In a fresh mkdtemp base, call installFakes with: a claude header whose sha256 is the digest of fakeBytes, followed by data of fakeBytes plus one '#' (size = the tampered length); then a valid codex binary; then end. Expect status 65 (EX_DATAERR), empty stdout, and readdirSync(<base>/agents) deep-equal to []: no binary and no staging dir. install_agents is all-or-nothing.
3. Fail closed. session = openSession(agentMain(base), {binding: BINDING, job: HOST_JOB, timeoutMs: 10_000}) rejects with SESSION_PROVIDER_FAILED (use rejectsWith). session.forwarded, session.observations and session.outputs are all []. The supervisor's host.proc.exitCode is 71 (EX_OSERR): GUARD's Popen finds no executable, so the supervisor sends hello and no observation (guest-supervisor.py run_bridge 'the guard could not start the job'). No stand-in is needed, because no job runs.
AE2 must kill two mutants: install_agents without its sha256 comparison, and a JOBS executable moved off AGENTS.

Verification, run once and fresh, after steps 1-2. On WSL:
`env -i HOME="$HOME" PATH="$HOME/.nvm/versions/node/v24.21.0/bin:/usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin" node --test scripts/tests/local-runner.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bundle.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-snapshot.test.mjs scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs`
This is the task's own four-file command plus local-runner-agents.test.mjs, whose AB, SH and TY rows hold the slice evidence for DoD items 1 and 2. AI, AH and RA are in local-runner.test.mjs.
- Exit 0 is required. AE1 and AE2 must PASS on Linux, not skip.
- While iterating, use --test-name-pattern='^AE[12] '.
- If a peer's uncommitted bytes turn the shared tree red, run the same command from a full-tree scratch copy and say so in the completion summary. CQ-R11e2 is editing guest-supervisor.py and local-runner.test.mjs right now. Build the copy as follows:
  - `git archive HEAD | tar -x -C <scratch>`;
  - copy in only this task's test file;
  - symlink <scratch>/packages/moe-daemon/dist to the shared checkout's dist, because TY1 reads the built daemon. Never run npm install or npm run build in the shared packages/moe-daemon.
- Submit this run's command, exit code and output tail to complete_task.
- No docs step: this is a mid-epic slice, and the CQ-R13 final task owns the docs sweep.

comments.author: architect-bd1eb82d
comments.content:
Split on 2026-10-29 (architect-bd1eb82d), SPIDR by interface, after two human decisions in the architect REPL:
1. CLI binaries come from a HOST pinned cache plus a copy-only supervisor stream. The guest never downloads.
2. FULL ACCESS INSIDE THE VM: claude runs with --dangerously-skip-permissions, and codex with --sandbox danger-full-access.

This row is now the orchestrator. It keeps its DoD and is BLOCKED on the slices, which form a serialized chain because they share files:
- CQ-R10d1 task-9faf1ef3: guest MCP stdio shim, tools.json, and its readiness hashes. It creates scripts/tests/local-runner-agents.test.mjs and adds it to CI.
- CQ-R10d2 task-4017cf1d: host pinned agent CLI cache (agent-binaries.json, agent-cache.mjs).
- CQ-R10d3 task-b8e7ad92: guest 'agents' copy-only install at /opt/moe/agents/<cli> (root 0555), plus readiness AGENT_MISSING and AGENT_HASH_MISMATCH.
- CQ-R10d4 task-60626bee: JOBS headless argv, the per-role prompt starting with moe.get_context, and the session MCP config naming only the shim. No resume or continue flag.

Plan this row once all four land. It composes them and tests them end to end through the real supervisor and the shim, with fake CLIs. The details are in the Serena memory decision-cq-r10d-split.

executionContract.intendedBehavior:
Tests only. Two new rows in scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs prove that the landed CQ-R10d1-5 slices compose end to end.
AE1: a fake claude or codex is installed through the real supervisor agents mode and started by the real bridge job (main(['bridge']) to start_job and prepare_launch) with its exact headless argv in the workspace. It reads its session MCP config, starts the real guest-mcp-shim.py from that config, and reaches the host session only through the agent socket, for exactly its role's tools, with fixed error codes.
AE2: a binary that misses its pinned sha256 is never installed and its job never starts.
No runtime file changes. executionReady stays false. No verified-local or isolation claim.
acceptanceCriteria: AE1 passes for claude/worker, claude/qa, codex/worker and codex/qa on Linux and macOS; it skips only on win32 or a python3 without tomllib.
The gate command exits 0, and its output is supplied to complete_task.
At most 300 changed lines in the one file. Every mutation (a)-(j) in step 4 is killed, or proven equivalent.
invariants: No edits outside scripts/tests/local-runner-bridge.test.mjs, and every pre-existing row there stays byte-identical.

The supervisor, shim, tools.json and host modules under test run unmodified. Only documented seams are used: main() keywords, install_agents' agents and owner arguments, and the shim's AGENT_SOCKET and TOOLS_PATH module globals in a test stand-in.
No __pycache__ is written under scripts/local-runner, every python file is loaded with -B, and nothing new is added to the supervisor CLI.
No .moe edits and no Git writes by the agent.
compatibility: win32 skips via NO_GUEST. macOS uses PEER's injected peer uid. Session sockets stay under mkdtemp(tmpdir()), within macOS's sun_path limit.
openSession and its DAEMON fixture stay as task-2cf1c6be lands them; this task depends on it.
reuse: The bridge test's LOAD, harness, PEER, sessions/after, openSession, launchArgv, LA_CONFIG, SPAWNED, SESSION_ID, KEY, HOST_JOB, QA_HOST_JOB, BINDING, QA and rejectsWith. agentMain copies bridgeMain's shape (H7).
The guest-bridge.mjs encodeFrame, createFrameDecoder, TOOLS and MAX_HOST_FRAME_BYTES; guest-bootstrap.mjs GUEST_LAYOUT.shim; agent-cache.mjs AGENT_CLIS.
sourceAssumptions: guest-mcp-shim.py main() == serve(os.environ.get('MOE_ROLE'), load_tools(TOOLS_PATH), AGENT_SOCKET), reading the module globals at call time. _Shim.run returns 0 at stdin EOF and drops pending calls. tools/list serves {type:object, properties: the tools.json fragments, additionalProperties:false}.

guest-session.mjs reply(): a forward throw becomes refusal BRIDGE_UPSTREAM_FAILED and the error is never echoed; STAMPED adds sessionId only to moe.get_context; scopeRequest stamps taskId and workerId per TOOLS entry.
Pinned codex 0.166 gives a stdio MCP server only HOME, PATH and LC_CTYPE plus the env_vars names; claude passes the whole env (CQ-R10d4 handoff).

planningNotes.approachesConsidered:
1. The e2e in local-runner-agents.test.mjs: rejected. It would duplicate the bridge-job and host-session harness that only the bridge file has: openSession, PEER, LOAD, sessions cleanup, launchArgv and LA_CONFIG. CQ-R13b (task-7fffec67) already expects this task to be the bridge file's last editor before its H4 fix.
2. Driving the host installAgents (R10d3) inside the e2e: rejected. AH3 already runs host cache to the real agents mode, and doing it here would need local-runner.test.mjs's fakeGuest mount-probe fakes in a file under active R11e edits. JS-built frames go straight into the real install_agents instead.
3. Running the pinned real codex or claude against the shim: out of scope. It needs the 319 MB member and a model endpoint, and CQ-R13 certifies on hardware.
4. Patching LAUNCH or SHIM in the harness so the config names a test path: rejected. Instead, the fake CLI maps the exact GUEST_LAYOUT.shim command to a local stand-in. That way the supervisor under test is byte-identical, and the CLI reads the real config bytes.
5. Any runtime change: none needed. DoD 1-3 are met by the landed slices, so this row's job is to prove they compose: install, then launch, then config, then shim, then socket, then host.
planningNotes.codebaseInsights:
- Composition gaps today:
  - The SH rows test the shim against a fake socket peer.
  - H5 and H7 test the real supervisor with raw-frame probe agents.
  - LA3 reads the config but starts no shim.
  - So nothing yet runs config, real shim, real agent-socket ingress and host session together. The CQ-R10d4 bug task-afe6838d (codex env_vars missing MOE_ROLE) would only have been caught by such a row.
- The shim's main() reads AGENT_SOCKET and TOOLS_PATH at call time, so a stand-in can re-root them without touching the file.
- At stdin EOF the shim exits 0 and drops pending calls, so the fake must be strictly request-then-reply.
- install_agents takes agents and owner arguments. main(['agents']) has no seams, so call install_agents directly, as AH3 does.
- start_job uses jobs[cli][0] as the executable. Re-rooting it with relpath(exe, m.AGENTS) both runs the installed file and pins the layout.
- If GUARD's Popen fails, the result is 71, with hello only and no observation; the host then reports SESSION_PROVIDER_FAILED.
- The host never sends a shim-passed call to the daemon if the call has a forbidden identity key: the shim's key allowlist (TOOLS args) refuses it first, as ARGUMENT_DENIED. So to get an end-to-end REFUSED, make forward throw, which gives BRIDGE_UPSTREAM_FAILED.
planningNotes.risks:
- Peer bytes:
  - CQ-R11e2 (task-1e7f5a2d) is editing guest-supervisor.py and local-runner.test.mjs right now, and R11e4 and R11e5 follow it. Do not edit those files. Their in-flight bytes can make the shared tree red, so use step 3's full-tree archive fallback.
  - task-2cf1c6be's openSession or DAEMON changes land before this task starts (it is in dependsOn).
  - CQ-R13b (task-7fffec67) also declares the bridge file but is gated on this task. Start from a clean file at pre-flight, so the default contested-path landing lands it.
- Portability:
  - Shebangs use python3's absolute sys.executable, because the job PATH is /usr/local/bin:/usr/bin:/bin and macOS python3 may live elsewhere.
  - tomllib needs python 3.11 or later. Every CI runner has 3.12+, and the explicit NO_TOMLLIB skip covers anything older.
  - LC_CTYPE may appear in the codex shim env (PEP 538), so pin names, not the full env.
- Hangs: signal.alarm in the fake, the test timeouts, and sessions/after() reaping all prevent a hung shim, job or supervisor from blocking node --test.
- The heredoc and Edit escape trap: keep the file ASCII.
- Size: about 150-250 lines is expected. Measure with git diff --numstat right after green.
- Do not use `__proto__` anywhere: it is a forbidden pattern.
- Any editing tool is fine; the plan mandates none, so codex seats can work it.
